snippet.title: Cropdeck - Official Playtest Trailer
snippet.description: Here's your look at gameplay from Cropdeck in this charming trailer for the upcoming farming roguelite deckbuilder game. In Cropdeck, craft a powerful deck of plants, navigate hazards, and use scarecrows with unique perks to overcome challenges and grow unbeatable combos. Cropdeck will be available on PC. A Playtest for Cropdeck begins July 17, 2025, with sign-ups available now on Steam.
